app.name: Duffel API JavaScript Client
app.one_liner: A TypeScript client library for interacting with the Duffel travel API, featuring automated code generation, semantic releases, and strong developer tooling.

screens.name: Developer Workspace
screens.purpose: Primary interface for developers to interact with the SDK through CLI commands and code editing.

rust_commands.name: commit_with_conventional_message
rust_commands.purpose: Creates a commit using Commitzen to ensure Angular/conventional commit format compliance.

rust_commands.name: generate_operation
rust_commands.purpose: Scaffolds a new API operation folder and files via interactive CLI prompt.

rust_commands.name: install_dependencies
rust_commands.purpose: Installs project dependencies as specified in package.json.

rust_commands.name: run_lint
rust_commands.purpose: Executes configured linters (ESLint, Prettier) to enforce code quality.

mvp_plan: week 1: Add script for generating new API operation scaffolds
week 1: Configure semantic-release with conventional commits
week 1: Implement core client structure with HTTP transport layer
week 1: Set up project with standard tooling (ESLint, Prettier, Husky, Jest)
acceptance_tests: Commits created via `yarn commit` pass Husky validation and trigger correct semantic versioning.
Merging to main triggers automated release workflow that publishes correct version to npm.
New API operations can be generated via `yarn generate:operation` and integrate cleanly into the build.
Security-related dependency bumps are applied promptly as evidenced by patch releases.
